title: Startup & Reliability Update
headline: Premium status shows instantly on every launch — no more split-second 'Free' flash. Plus smoother hardware detection and under-the-hood stability fixes.
changes: Fixed: Premium badge now appears instantly on startup — the brief 'Free' flash before cloud verification is completely eliminated.
Fixed: Grace cache now bridges the cloud round-trip so your premium status is accurate from the very first frame, not after a 1-2 second delay.
Fixed: Startup revert guard correctly defers on fast-path boot, preventing false tweak-reverts for premium users after an update.
Fixed: GPU VRAM now shows the correct amount for modern GPUs — RX 7800 XT shows 16 GB, not 4 GB.
Improved: Entitlement resolver has a dedicated startup priority branch that shows Premium from the local cache while cloud confirmation is in flight.
Improved: AMD/WMI hardware probes are more reliable with longer timeouts and smarter cooldown logic.
